description: This file defines the CellFormatRenderer class responsible for rendering cell formatting in RTF documents within the MigraDoc library, including borders, shading, padding, and cell boundaries.

classes.name: CellFormatRenderer
classes.description: A class that renders the formatting of a table cell, including borders, shading, padding, and merging in RTF format.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Renders the cell’s shading, borders, padding, and merging controls for RTF output.

methods.name: RenderLeftRightPadding
methods.description: Renders the left and right padding controls for the cell.

methods.name: GetRightCellBoundary
methods.description: Calculates and returns the right boundary position of the cell in RTF units.
